200.description:
Observations of one dataflow selected by country, other dimension codes and period, as records. Give `filters` (dimension id to code(s); REF_AREA is the country) or a raw `key`, plus optional start_period/end_period. Unknown dimensions or codes without data fail with invalid_input listing the valid ones; a combination with no data is not_found. Selections above 50,000 observations are rejected: add filters or a period range. One data download per page (OECD allows about 60 per hour); rows are sorted canonically and the cursor pins the dataflow version and segment hash, so a publication change fails with upstream_error `publication_changed` instead of mixing data. Each record carries every dimension and attribute code, obs_value, time_period, series_key, source_record_id and source_url; Revenue Statistics and financial market rows also get a typed `mapped` view. Common dataflows: merchandise trade incl. G20 aggregate OECD.SDD.TPS:DSD_IMTS@DF_IMTS, quarterly services/goods trade (balance of payments) OECD.SDD.TPS:DSD_BOP@DF_BOP, Revenue Statistics OECD.CTP.TPS:DSD_REV_COMP_OECD@DF_RSOECD, SOCX OECD.ELS.SPD:DSD_SOCX_AGG@DF_SOCX_AGG, quarterly sector accounts OECD.SDD.NAD:DSD_NASEC1@DF_QSA; structure_get and dataflows_list list their key codes.

The response contains the tool result directly.
